sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (micro insurance product; specified in Certificate of Insurance)

room_rent.note: Default is up to 1% of Coverage Amount per day. Optional Benefit 7 (Room Rent Modification) can change this to a different % or no sub-limit as specified in Certificate of Insurance.

icu.note: Up to 2% of Coverage Amount per day. If Optional Benefit 7 is opted, ICU is twice the non-ICU % opted.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.display: Room rent capped; day care listed only
sub_limits.note: Room rent capped at 1% of SI/day (base); day care limited to listed procedures in Annexure I; no other explicit disease sub-limits stated.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible for Base Benefit 1. Optional Benefit 6 (Daily Cash Allowance) has a deductible in number of days before daily cash is payable, but that is specific to that optional benefit.

initial_waiting.note: Waivable via Optional Benefit 2 (Waiver of Initial Waiting Period) for an additional premium.

ped_waiting.note: Policy states pre-existing diseases are covered from inception of the Policy subject to exclusions (Clause 3.1). No separate PED waiting period is mentioned for Base Benefit 1.

specific_disease_waiting.note: No named-disease specific waiting period is explicitly listed in the policy wording beyond the standard 30-day initial waiting period.

maternity.note: Base Benefit 1 includes Maternity Expenses (Clause 3.1.4) with 9-month waiting period. Waiting period waivable via Optional Benefit 3. Coverage up to Coverage Amount; limited to first two living children; insured must be 18-45 years; covers normal/caesarean delivery, miscarriage, congenital diseases of newborn.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus / no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: Clause 3.1.5: Coverage Amount reinstated once per Cover Year after exhaustion; reinstated amount available only for future claims not related to the illness/injury for which a claim was already admitted.

pre_hosp.note: Default is 1 day pre-hospitalisation. Can be modified via Optional Benefit 4 (Modification of Pre & Post Hospitalisation Medical Expenses) to a duration specified in Certificate of Insurance.

post_hosp.note: Default is 5 days post-hospitalisation. Can be modified via Optional Benefit 4 to a duration specified in Certificate of Insurance.

day_care.note: Day care covered only for procedures listed in Annexure I of the policy.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization is defined (Clause 2.1.15) but not listed as a covered benefit under Base Benefit 1 or any optional benefit.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatments covered under Clause 3.1.6 up to Coverage Amount, subject to claim admissibility under In-patient Care (Base Benefit 1). Covers Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Siddha, Unani, Homeopathy.

organ_donor.note: Clause 4.2.2(xvii) explicitly excludes all expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from the donor in case of transplant surgery.

ambulance.note: Ambulance is listed as an excluded non-medical item in Annexure II (List I, item 67), suggesting ambulance charges are not covered.

modern_treatments.note: Advanced Technology Methods listed in Clause 3.1.2 Note are covered under In-patient Care and Day Care Treatment (robotic surgeries, stereotactic radio surgeries, oral chemotherapy, etc.). Other advance technology methods are excluded per Clause 4.2.2(x).

consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, etc.) as excluded.

global_cover.note: Clause 4.2.2(xx) explicitly excludes treatment received outside India. Clause 6.6(a) states policy covers treatment taken entirely within India.

moratorium.note: Clause 5.1.10: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other cases.

free_look.note: 30 days from receipt of policy document; not applicable at renewal.

portability.note: Clause 5.1.12 provides portability as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions: Organ donor expenses, OPD treatment, overseas treatment, domiciliary hospitalisation, ambulance, dental/cosmetic, infertility/ART, self-inflicted injury, hazardous activities
optional_riders: Accidental Death, Permanent Total/Partial Disablement, Accidental Hospitalisation, Waiver of Initial Waiting Period, Waiver of Maternity Waiting Period, Modified Pre/Post-Hosp duration, Modified Maternity limit, Daily Cash Allowance, Room Rent Modification
